architecture: v2 (re-root at the batch 1 audit: a US flexible packaging converter's 2026 VOC emissions against its 95-ton synthetic minor limit, the oxidizer's fixed air capacity a fixed solvent capacity because every dryer holds its exhaust at a quarter of the lower explosive limit, so the bypass vents only the solvent above that capacity)
slot_note: re-root of task456 in the same objective (Data Extraction & Conformation), batch 1; architecture 1 (the hospital bed-status feeds' latent class model) spent at the batch 1 audit; new world (a flexible packaging converter's air permit), new dataset, new shell
niche: a flexible packaging converter's 2026 actual VOC emissions under its synthetic minor permit, conformed from the ink room's issues and returns by press job, the presses' job logs, the regenerative thermal oxidizer's 15-minute record, the waste solvent shipments and the stack test, in the year a sixth press started up and the presses' combined dryer exhaust outran the oxidizer's air capacity at peak
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the ink room's issues and returns, the job logs and the oxidizer's 15-minute record and reads the permit (VOC emitted is VOC applied less the VOC the oxidizer destroyed, VOC routed through the bypass uncontrolled) counts the bypass at all the solvent the running presses applied while the bypass damper stood open, or at the plant's average application rate over those hours, and files 2026 far over or under the 95-ton limit; the oxidizer treated its full air capacity throughout every bypass and each dryer holds its exhaust at a quarter of the lower explosive limit, so only the solvent load above the capacity's solvent equivalent went untreated, and 2026 lands between the two, over the limit by a margin neither shortcut gives.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the plant's 2026 actual VOC emissions, which an air permit engineer estimates from a solvent mass balance with the control device's destruction efficiency, its capture and its bypass, worked here as the solvent load in each 15 minutes above the oxidizer's capacity expressed in solvent through the dryers' LEL setpoint; with another field's nouns there is no lower explosive limit holding exhaust in proportion to solvent, no oxidizer sized in air volume and no bypass of the excess, and the task stops reading the same.
layer1: the oxidizer's DCS export in UTC at 15-minute intervals, its tags renamed at the March control system upgrade
the presses' job logs in plant local time, the five older presses on the plant MES and the new press on its vendor's system in metric units
ink and solvent issues and returns by job from the ink room, returns booked on later dates against the original job, and press-side solvent drawn from drums logged separately
jobs paused and resumed, some moved to another press under the same job number with a suffix
waste solvent shipped quarterly for recovery, each manifest with the recycler's VOC content by lot
inks' VOC content in pounds per gallon from formulation sheets, re-issued mid-year for two ink series
stakeholder_role: the plant's environmental manager, who certifies the 2026 annual emissions statement and answers the state's full compliance evaluation

spine.entity: one 15-minute interval of the oxidizer's record (inlet flow, combustion chamber temperature, bypass damper position)

world.geography: United States (a fictional flexible packaging converter in a fictional county of a fictional state; the company, the state air division and the people are fictional)
world.org_type: a flexible packaging converter running six printing presses under a synthetic minor air permit

driver: The decisive quantity is a release a control device stops only up to a fixed capacity, set in one unit while the release accrues in another, the two tied by a setpoint every source holds; whenever the sources' combined demand passes the capacity the excess goes untreated, so the untreated amount is each interval's combined load above the capacity's equivalent in the release's unit, not the whole load while the relief stood open and not the average load over those intervals.
driver_concrete: The VOC the bypass vented is each 15-minute interval's combined solvent load of the running presses above the oxidizer's air capacity expressed in solvent at the dryers' 25 per cent LEL setpoint, summed over the intervals the bypass damper stood open.
stump: A competent solver conforms the issues, the jobs and the oxidizer record and, reading the permit's bypass clause, counts as uncontrolled all the solvent the presses applied while the bypass damper stood open, or the plant's average application rate over those hours; the step that lands it there is treating the bypass as the presses' whole exhaust or their average, when the oxidizer kept treating its full air capacity throughout and each dryer's exhaust is held at a quarter of the LEL, so only the solvent above the capacity's solvent equivalent went untreated.

lineage.architecture: v1 (the regional hospital bed-status feeds read through a latent class model of their agreement)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-01 at the batch 1 audit, never returned by the portal: short of the survivor anatomy on every line (the feeds' agreement pattern is the latent class model's own textbook input, so the field's method sat at the top of the ladder), an unmeasured ask ceiling, a prompt stating the feed count, and two pack files that describe the data (leak.py LEAK)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how often a state held in each group of units, seen only through three independent records that each miss some instances and flag some non-instances, one catching nearly every instance but also a third of non-instances and two rarely flagging a non-instance but missing most instances, so every rule that settles each unit from its records either keeps the first record's false flags or drops most instances, and only a latent class model of the three records, their miss and false-flag rates estimated from how they agree and the state's frequency free in each group, counts the instances.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst conforms the three feeds to hospital-days, counts a day full when any feed shows it full (the compact's 'at some time during the day') and activates all eight regions instead of four; the step that lands it there is settling each hospital-day from the feeds' flags instead of estimating each region's share of full days from a latent class model of how often each feed misses a full day or flags an ordinary one.
lineage.niche: a statewide hospital alliance's ICU surge compact, whose regional trigger counts full adult-ICU hospital-days that three conflicting capacity feeds (a 07:00 census survey, a transfer-status board, a transfer center's declines) each record imperfectly

differentiation.task459: task459 carries a ratio that changes with a unit's operating level across the year; here no ratio is carried: a shared device's fixed capacity binds only in the intervals the sources' combined demand passes it, and the untreated amount is the excess over it.
differentiation.task482: task482 splits one site meter's fuel among products by each process's physical driver; here nothing is split among products: the question is how much of one stream a full device could not take, read against a capacity the device's own meter shows it held.
differentiation.task98: task98 v2 sizes how many listed units a persons target needs once arrivals join units already in place, a forward count over an ordered list; here nothing is counted forward or ordered: a shared device's fixed capacity is passed only in some intervals, and the untreated release is the excess over it in those intervals.
differentiation.task156: task156 v2 counts how often a pump station's consented capacity is passed once a new steady load is added, a frequency carried into a coming year; here the year just closed is accounted, and the untreated release is the amount above the oxidizer's capacity in the intervals it was passed, the capacity's air volume turned into solvent through the dryers' LEL setpoint.
